definitions.explanation: A formal or official term for a house or building used for residence. Often appears in legal, real estate, and insurance contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{多|おお}くの→多い：01127_ooi⟧{家屋|かおく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: Many houses were damaged by the typhoon.

examples.japanese: {家屋|かおく}⟦{調査|ちょうさ}→調査：03489_chousa⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{来週|らいしゅう}→来週：00746_raishuu⟧⟦{行|おこな}われます→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: The building inspection will be conducted next week.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧{家屋|かおく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{弱|よわ}い→弱い：00825_yowai⟧⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Old buildings may be vulnerable to earthquakes.

notes:
REGISTER: Formal/official. Used in legal documents, news reports, insurance, and real estate contexts.

COMMON CONTEXTS:
・{家屋|かおく}{調査|ちょうさ} (building inspection)
・{家屋|かおく}{税|ぜい} (property tax on buildings)
・{家屋|かおく}{倒壊|とうかい} (building collapse)
・{家屋|かおく}{被害|ひがい} (building damage)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{家|いえ} (house - general, casual)
・{住宅|じゅうたく} (residence, housing - slightly formal)
・{建物|たてもの} (building - general)
・{住居|じゅうきょ} (dwelling - formal)

NOTE: In everyday conversation, use {家|いえ} or {建物|たてもの}. {家屋|かおく} sounds formal or bureaucratic.
